title: Bloom Into You
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: High schooler Yuu Koito has never felt romantic love, until student council president Touko Nanami confesses to her. As they prepare a school play, Yuu explores her own feelings and Touko's fear of being herself (to verify).
life_message: A life of discovering and accepting one's own feelings and identity honestly.

content.note: Romance between high schoolers Yuu (15) and Touko (16) with kisses from early on; Wikipedia says they have sex for the first time in chapter 44, which the author felt should not be omitted; the Okazu review of volume 8 confirms a sex scene. Explicitness not described (to verify).
content.frequency: Kisses recurring; one sex scene near the end
